summary: Quantum Biopharma Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release that provides a corporate update. The update discloses that the FDA placed its IND for Lucid-MS on clinical hold, requiring additional information before a Phase 2 trial can proceed. The company is reviewing the FDA's comments and plans to submit a response. Separately, Dr. Lakshmi P. Kotra resigned as director and from all positions, effective June 1, 2026, but will stay as a senior clinical advisor. This is a routine regulatory update regarding a clinical hold and a director resignation that is not abrupt or forced in a manner constituting a standalone special-situation event. No deal terms, special-situation mechanics, or transaction structure are involved.
